name: ACA 219 TCAS机动 复飞 备降/返航

cards.audioText: Your call sign is ACA 219, from Vancouver to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11,000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3555, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 ACA 219，从温哥华飞往武汉，正保持 11,000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3555，与武汉管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 219, maintaining 2000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3555.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 219，正保持 2000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3555。

cards.audioText: ACA 219, Wuhan Control, radar contact, reduce speed to mach decimal 75 due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 219，武汉管制，雷达识别，因流量控制将速度减至 Mach 0.75。
cards.referenceText: reduce speed to mach decimal seven five, ACA 219.

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，下降到 9200 米，减速到 270 节以下，直到通知。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 9200 米，减速到 270 节以下，直到通知，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your TCAS indicates there is a converging traffic at your 2 o'clock, below, climbing, confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with you.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 下降过程中，你的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有交叉交通，在下方，正在爬升，向武汉管制确认是否与你冲突。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 219, our TCAS indicates there is a converging traffic at our 2 o'clock, below, climbing, is it in conflict with us?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 219，我们的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有交叉交通，在我们下方，正在爬升，是否与我们冲突？

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, negative, the aircraft is climbing to 8900 meters, it will cross behind your shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，否，该飞机正在爬升到 8900 米，很快将在你后方穿越。

cards.audioText: B: You have just received the latest ATIS, saying the visibility at Wuhan is low, you want to know if your alternate airport Changsha is available for diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你刚收到最新 ATIS，说 Wuhan 能见度低，你想知道备降机场 Changsha 是否可用于改航。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 219, the latest ATIS says the visibility at Wuhan is low, is Changsha available for diversion?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 219，最新 ATIS 说 Wuhan 能见度低，Changsha 是否可用于改航？

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 219, Changsha Airport is available, confirm you are diverting to Changsha?
B: Tell the controller you are not diverting to Changsha at the moment, and you still want to fly to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 219，Changsha Airport 可用，确认你要改航 Changsha？
B: 告诉管制员目前不改航 Changsha，仍想飞往 Wuhan。
cards.referenceText: We won't divert at the moment, we still want to fly to Wuhan, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们目前不改航，仍想飞往 Wuhan，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: ACA 219, roger, track direct to ZF, follow Z FOXTROT-2A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 219，收到，直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: track direct to ZF, follow ZF two A Arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，下降并保持 4200 米，减速到最小光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，减速到最小光洁速度，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: Now you are established on ILS approach Runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，距接地点 15 英里，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, established ILS Runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 219，已建立 ILS Runway 36R，距接地点 15 英里。

cards.audioText: ACA 219, roger, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550m, midpoint 600 meters, rollout 500m, continue approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 219，收到，地面静风，RVR 接地区 550m、中段 600 米、滑跑端 500m，继续进近 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud information.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你距接地点 10 海里，向武汉塔台询问云况信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, 10 miles from touchdown, request cloud information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 219，距接地点 10 海里，请求云况信息。

cards.audioText: ACA 219, cloud broken 700m, cleared to land Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 219，碎云 700m，许可在 Runway 36R 落地。
cards.referenceText: cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land Runway 36R, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 碎云 700 米，许可在 Runway 36R 落地，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: At the minimum, you are unable to see approach lights, you are carrying out a missed approach, advise Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 在最低标准高度，你看不到进近灯，正在执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText:
Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, we are unable to see approach lights at minimum, going around.
(no contact at the minimum)
cards.referenceTextZh:
武汉塔台，ACA 219，我们在最低标准高度看不到进近灯，复飞。
（最低标准高度无目视）

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，收到，执行标准复飞程序，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, ACA 219.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, inform Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正在爬升到复飞高度，决定改航 Changsha Airport，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, request divert to Changsha Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 219，请求改航 Changsha Airport。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, roger, turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，收到，右转，直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米，ACA 219。
